summary.text: Mike Thurow, an independent candidate who describes himself as a firefighter, HAZMAT specialist and father of four, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House seat in Wisconsin's 6th Congressional District to Glenn Grothman, receiving 1.2% of the vote to Grothman's 52.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
He said he was running to continue as a public servant, and he had not held elected office.
